messages.author: b25fe113ed47f0e6
messages.subject: Maven Error using Renjin
parts:
Hi all,
 
  I am starting integrating renjin in my application with maven, but I am facing an error. 

I added in my pom.xml 
 
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.renjin</groupId>
  <artifactId>renjin-script-engine</artifactId>
  <version>0.7.0-RC6</version>
</dependency>
...
<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>bedatadriven</id>
    <name>bedatadriven public repo</name>
    <url>http://nexus.bedatadriven.com/content/groups/public/</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>
When I use maven, I got this error (running with -X ):

[DEBUG] Noticed class org.renjin.primitives.R.primitive.. in /Users/lucastucchi/.m2/repository/org/renjin/renjin-core/0.7.0-RC6/renjin-core-0.7.0-RC6.jar.
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal org.codehaus.enunciate:maven-enunciate-plugin:1.28:assemble (default) on project ws: Problem assembling the enunciate app. String index out of range: 0
Caused by: java.lang.StringIndexOutOfBoundsException: String index out of range: 0
at java.lang.String.charAt(String.java:658)
at org.codehaus.enunciate.main.ImportedClassesClasspathHandler.handleResource(ImportedClassesClasspathHandler.java:55) 

This seems to be a maven problem, already fixed but not yet released... see 

https://github.com/stoicflame/enunciate/issues/42

this is my maven version

$ mvn --version
Apache Maven 3.2.1 (ea8b2b07643dbb1b84b6d16e1f08391b666bc1e9; 2014-02-14T18:37:52+01:00)
Maven home: /usr/local/apache-maven-3.2.1
Java version: 1.7.0_55, vendor: Oracle Corporation
Java home: /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk1.7.0_55.jdk/Contents/Home/jre
Default locale: en_US, platform encoding: UTF-8
OS name: "mac os x", version: "10.9.2", arch: "x86_64", family: "mac"

Did anybody meet this issue before ? And most of all, found a way to solve it ? Or could suggest a way to solve this little but blocking issue ?

Thanks in advance,

  Luca

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Maven Error using Renjin
parts:
Bummer, sorry, if I understand correctly, enunciate is having a problem with classnames that end in "$" ?
Renjin uses a convention similar to Scala's and I think changing it would break existing builds out there, maybe not the best idea.

It seems like the enunciate developer has already fixed the problem - you could work around this by building a snapshot of ennunciate yourself from the master branch:

git clone https://github.com/stoicflame/enunciate.git
cd enunciate 
mvn install

Then you can reference enunciate version 1.29-SNAPSHOT and it should treat Renjin's classes correctly.

HTH

Alex

messages.subject: Re: Maven Error using Renjin
parts:
Hi Alex,
 
  in case anyone else will follow this way, let me leave an indication for some rows to add, that will prevent some compile/fail/modifyfile/recompile cycles

in the main pom.xml you need to add these boolean variables if you don't want to build C, .NET, ruby and PHP executables.
This comes straight from git diff pom.xml

<jersey.version>1.11</jersey.version>
     <jackson.version>1.9.3</jackson.version>
     <donations.url>https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=HXSXBXUT63RCG</donations.url>
+    <gcc.executable>true</gcc.executable>
+    <gmcs.executable>true</gmcs.executable>
+    <ruby.executable>true</ruby.executable>
+    <php.executable>true</php.executable>
   </properties>

HTH
  Luca

P.S. anyway it's too bad maven automatic compile fails... :(
